hook: Your Voyager 1 message arrives nearly a day late.
title: Your Voyager 1 Message Is Almost A Day Old
description:
Voyager 1 launched in 1977 and now flies in interstellar space. Its radio signal travels at the speed of light, yet it takes close to a full day to reach Earth. The probe is still sending data home.

#Shorts #Voyager1 #SpaceFacts
comment_prompt: Would you wait a day for a reply? Yes or no
